title: A skill is only the start
body: A fictional learner knows introductory HTML but cannot yet explain its relevance to a real employer. Career Bridge turns that starting point into a portable preparation plan.
caption: Genuine working-app screenshots. Fictional learner; no measured human outcomes.

title: Discover a real source
body: Choose MPT’s Media Literacy Student Fellow recruitment. Inspect the original official source and review date. An old review never guarantees current availability.
caption: Source facts and review holds remain visible. Applicant eligibility stays unknown.

title: Connect learning to work
body: Introductory HTML connects directly to MPT’s reviewed educational-web duty. The library page is a proposed fictional sample, with a reasoned explanation and outstanding conditions.
caption: Direct source link, transferable skill and general exploration are labeled separately.

title: Try a relevant exercise
body: The existing Accessibility Artifact quest checks five fictional repairs. Its local HTML sample demonstrates the exercise result; it is not a credential or employer-approved portfolio.
caption: A checked fictional exercise does not establish WCAG conformance or eligibility.

title: Leave with three actions
body: For a stale or held source, recheck the current announcement and documents first. Then prepare a proposed sample and ask a specific enrollment, schedule or task question. Each action retains its unresolved condition.
caption: Source check first when stale. Exactly three actions; proposed preparation is not completed professional work.

title: Keep uncertainty honest
body: Select a skill with no supported source connection. The tool says general exploratory learning instead of inventing a duty. Enrollment, authorization and employer acceptance still need human review.
caption: No eligibility, hiring probability, automatic application or employer response is produced.

title: Export, then test usefulness
body: Download the actual Markdown or JSON Career Bridge Plan. Proposed first stage: five adults and five double-reviewed sources, with independent plan ratings and explicit cost/safety gates.
caption: No host committed. Zero verified timed human sessions. Inspect the plan and pilot assumptions.
